title: Weekly ODNI briefings for national-security reporters (Mockingbird)

tellings.quote: They they go to places like OD and I on a weekly basis and get their briefing for what they're going to talk about next week.

plain: National-security reporters go every week to the Office of the Director of National Intelligence, the office that oversees the US spy agencies, and get briefed on what they will talk about the following week. That is the claim of Matthew Brown, a guest the episode presents as a Pentagon whistleblower, who speaks of it as something he knows first-hand. If true, it would mean some of the news on these subjects is steered by the intelligence world before it reaches the public.
